comment: Tree species for shared/trees/generator.ts. A species = its materials (the NatureManufacture shader materials Unity draws it with, the atlas rectangles that are its twigs, the pictures the web editor shows), its own defaults laid over the generator's, its presets laid over those, and optionally `lods` = its own detail levels (tube sides per branch order, share of cards kept) in place of the generator's. Unity material: `from` = the NatureManufacture material copied as a template, `textures` = shader property -> texture asset name (a course's own tinted copy when it has one), `ctiNormals` = shader property -> a normal map in Forst's CTI packing, converted for the NM shader, `floats` = shader property -> number, `colors` = shader property -> [r, g, b]; all set on the copy. atlasAspect = the leaf atlas' width over its height when not square. Sprite rect = u0, v0, u1, v1 in the leaf atlas (origin bottom left), base = where the twig's stem starts, hang = a twig that falls straight down from its base (birch, weeping willow), along = a base at the top on a twig that follows its branch all the same (spruce sprays). web = files under the Unity project's Assets folder, copied for the editor by `bun run trees -- textures`. `atlas` = a leaf atlas drawn in the repo (shared/trees/atlas/<atlas>.png, pipeline/tree_atlas.py) in place of a pack's; the Unity material then names it under `ownTextures` as `GolfMap Tree Atlas <atlas>` ('' = no texture on that property).
